mask_protocol: legacy reproduction: independent first20 generated hand validity / last2 wrist validity AND per-angle finite before cleanup
notes: Only all saved physical window centers and their two20+2 validity masks were read. Actual point payload6,232,488bytes, not a full scan of66,161,725 timeline rows.

Original local-transfer hashes identify previously acquired files; this operation records actual fd/path stability and hashes center coordinates+raw point bytes, without claiming a new full-payload hash or publisher authentication.
A synchronized window center, a single-hand center and a valid angle are separate denominators. by_hand shares the same physical windows; do not sum its window counts as independent windows.
Legacy mask is first20 generated-valid AND finite, last2 wrist-valid AND finite before cleanup; this is not the new classic official-literal two-dimensional mask.
Unknown gesture=-1 and raw50 are separate exclusions. Invalid gesture/activity does not by itself mean invalid joint labels.
No model prediction, crop read, per-user metric or paper Table14/15 error result is included.
scope: all explicitly frozen windows; shared center labels, two independent hand masks

source_identity.point_digest_definition: SHA256 of sorted center uint64 little-endian followed by raw row bytes per field
source_identity.transfer_hash_scope: recorded local-transfer identities; complete payloads not rehashed here

window_protocol.center_definition: window_start + floor(window_length/2), absolute synchronized row; not substituted with an EMG-token midpoint
window_protocol.cohort: saved legacy four-baseline partition; not the new classic7790 grid
window_protocol.released_splits: original frame_split_id labels train/user/gesture/both, separate from independent roles
window_protocol.roles: independent train/val/test roles; val consists of original train rows
